verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK is an open-source Python/JS library (github.com/openai/openai-agents-python) that you install and run yourself via the Runner class (Runner.run/run_sync/run_streamed) with no required hosted backend, and it's provider-agnostic (100+ LLMs), meaning the core execution loop runs entirely in your own infrastructure by design. Missing for 10: no explicit self-hosting guide/deployment docs or independent report confirming production self-hosted deployments beyond code examples.
